text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: [P0] unusual outbound telemetry from inference-gateway-prod -> s3.us-east-1[.]external-collector.com. detected high-rate POSTs with auth: Bearer <svc-token-like>. triage channel created.
sara: I'm on it. seeing ~2k reqs/min from gateway-01 and gateway-03, started ~00:12 UTC. dropping some sample headers to #sec-logs.
mike: thanks. initial check: requests contain session_id hashes and truncated debug traces. not yet seeing plaintext customer content in sampled bodies. uploading sample to s3-sec (restricted).
claire: I can isolate the two gateways to a quarantine SG and block outbound to that FQDN at edge. want me to put an immediate egress deny? :warning:
sara: yes block outbound to that host now, apply deny at edge. also add WAF rule to block content-type: application/x-telemetry-json for that host.
claire: done — egress rule applied to gateway-01/gateway-03, WAF rule pushed. outbound to 52.23.45.67 blocked. confirm network telemetry dropping.
natalie: observability: traffic rate dropped to ~30 reqs/min after block. however there are still background retries from >10 other hosts. listing top sources: gateway-*.zc, inference-batch-2.
sec-rotations: recommend immediate rotation of service principal used by inference-gateway to talk to telemetry endpoint. creating rotation ticket and ephemeral keys now.
sara: which principal? svc-inference-gateway-prod? we should rotate that and any associated short-lived tokens. also rotate any API keys in secrets manager with last-used in the last 48h.
mike: confirmed principal = svc-inference-gateway-prod (IAM role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-inference-gateway-prod). generating rotation plan: 1) create new role creds, 2) update deployment env var, 3) throttle old creds and revoke. estimated 12m.
ops: prepping a hotpatch deploy to swap creds on gateway instances, will do a rolling restart to avoid customer impact. ETA 8m.
sara: quick customer impact note: so far no authenticated user payloads exfil'd, traces look like internal debug payloads + hashed ids. still mark as potential data-exposure until scrub & logs validated. notify support/cust-bridge if anything changes.
legal: please stub out a timeline for next 30m and preserve all samples. if we confirm non-PII, we'll avoid external notification for now but keep me posted.
sec-rotations: rotation ticket created: ROT-2956. performing creds swap now, will also push automated secret deletion for the old token in 1h after validation loop.
claire: creds swapped on gateway-01, gateway-03. rolling restart started (gradual, 2 instances at a time). health checks passing.
mike: running a grep across recent log archive for any base64 blobs or long payloads. posted findings to /secure/incidents/2956789012/results.txt — no obvious customer text. a few debug dumps with stack traces referencing feature flags.
sara: good. next: run scrub job to remove samples from external collector (we can't access external host) and run internal log purge for the last 3 hours from staging and prod archives. ops coordinate with infra.
ops: started purge job on prod logs (filter: inference-gateway-prod, timestamp >= 2026-03-18T00:00Z). estimated 20m. will post status.
natalie: adding anomaly badge to dashboards and creating an alert to catch any retry spikes. also capturing request IDs for full trace playback if needed.
sec-rotations: old token revoked at 2956789100. verified no successful calls with the old token post-revocation. marking ROT-2956 stage=revoked.
legal: timeline received. we need a one-paragraph internal summary for execs once we confirm no customer data. please draft after purge completes.
sara: drafting internal summary now, will include what we blocked, rotation steps, customer-impact assessment (none seen so far), and follow-ups: 1) secret hygiene audit 2) limit egress allowlist 3) scrub/playback verification.
claire: purge job completed — removed ~140MB of archived payloads that matched telemetry signature. job ID P-2956-01.
mike: replayed traces for the captured request IDs. all payloads are debug telemetry + hashed ids, no user messages. marking as likely no-customer-PII. will attach verification logs.
sara: ok. i'll mark incident as contained and hand off to night-oncall for 12h watch. still leave alert and rotation ticket open until post-mortem.
night-oncall: Picking up handoff. will monitor alerts at 00:30Z, 01:30Z and escalate immediately if any egress resumes. contact list on call doc updated.
sec-rotations: follow-ups: schedule secret rotation sweep for all inference-related service principals tomorrow morning, and propose a policy to disallow unrestricted egress to unknown FQDNs from prod by default.
legal: thanks. preserve all artifacts for 90 days per policy. we'll advise on external comms only if evidence of customer-content exfil appears.
sara: incident state: contained -> network egress block + creds rotated + purge completed. severity -> P0->contained. next steps: postmortem owner @mike, draft postmortem and remediation items within 48h. :white_check_mark:
ops: leaving a runbook note: when similar outbound telemetry spikes occur, immediate steps: 1) temp egress deny 2) rotate creds 3) purge external deliveries 4) notify legal/support.
night-oncall: acknowledged. handing off channel. good night team.
